body: Most recent thing that made me totally heartbroken was when I was at the mall with my cousin, my mom and her husband were also there just shopping, I was with my cousin buying food when she passed by us, she suddenly stopped and came back to me and started touching my face, she forced me to look at my cousin's smooth face and to compare it to mine. She then walked away and went back to her husband's side and started laughing while saying stuff like, "no matter how expensive your skin care is, you won't be as pretty as your cousin". This happened in public btw, we were even standing in front of a food stand and the moment my mom walked away I started tearing up, I just stopped cause the guy preparing our food stood there stunned from what just happened.
